_comment: Scripted model turn for demo/record.sh, served by tests/e2e/fake_model.mjs. @WORKSPACE@ is replaced with the demo workspace path. The tool calls really run in the demo's Neovim: execute_command starts a pdb session with nvim-gdb (:GdbStartPDB), whose source window marks the current line with a sign; each exec_lua call sends its arguments to pdb one at a time with nvim-gdb's :Gdb command, waits for pdb's next prompt in nvim-gdb's terminal after each, and returns what pdb printed for the last one.

steps.text: Starting a pdb session on `stats.py` with nvim-gdb.
Breaking in the loop, on line 4, to print `i`, `xs[i]` and `total`.

input.code:
-- nvim-gdb's debugger terminal (filetype nvimgdb)
local b = vim.iter(vim.api.nvim_list_bufs()):find(function(b) return vim.bo[b].filetype == 'nvimgdb' end)
local function prompts() return vim.fn.matchbufline(b, '(Pdb)', 1, '$') end
for _, cmd in ipairs({...}) do
  local n = #prompts()
  vim.cmd.Gdb(cmd) -- nvim-gdb's :Gdb sends the command to the debugger
  vim.wait(5000, function() return #prompts() > n end)
end
local p = prompts()
return vim.fn.getbufline(b, p[#p - 1].lnum + 1, p[#p].lnum - 1)

steps.text: pdb stopped on line 4, which nvim-gdb marks with ▶ in the script, and prints `(1, 8, 0)`: on the first pass `i` is already 1, so `xs[0]`, the 4, is never added.
`range(1, len(xs))` starts at index 1: it sums 8 + 6 = 14 and divides by 3, hence 4.67. It should start at 0.
